decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 48 Harewood Road.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the  northwest elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  northwest and southeast walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey front extension and porch, a single storey rear extension and a side and rear roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
